text:
maya: Quick heads-up — Lumina Health confirmed pilot start Tue 10am PT. Need to lock SSO, enablement demo, and feedback cadence before then. Alex from Lumina is on-thread.

alex_lumina: Thanks Maya — yep confirmed. We can do Tue 10am. SSO is via Okta, but we'll need a checklist for what to provision. Also want a 20m enablement + 40m hands-on.

maya: Perfect. @ari can you own SSO checklist and provisioning steps? Also capture the invite list (engineer + product manager).

ari: on it — will draft checklist and send to Alex by EOD today. Quick Q: do they need sandbox tokens or full test account?

alex_lumina: Sandbox tokens are fine for the pilot. We'll give an engineer who can toggle configs.

samir: FYI from infra/product: for sandbox we'll route to the dev model variant (rdw-dev-1). If they plan to test longer sequences, flag it so we can pre-warm KV caches.

maya: Good call @samir. Alex, can you share a sample prompt set or 5 representative queries we should test for latency/quality?

alex_lumina: I'll paste a short set now: 1) patient-summary extraction from notes, 2) care-plan suggestion, 3) triage-symptom classifier, 4) short-safe-answer generator, 5) explanation for clinician.

maya: Nice — that covers it. Proposed feedback cadence: 24h post-kickoff we run a quick NPS + bug capture, then weekly syncs for first 3 weeks. Thoughts?

alex_lumina: Sounds reasonable. Weekly ok. For the 24h check I want a short form we can fill.

ari: I'll create a 6-question form (quality, latency, broken flows, how-to docs, security concerns, overall satisfaction) and share link before kickoff.

samir: Also adding a monitoring dashboard tile for their org id so we can track latency, errors, and token spend in real time.

maya: Awesome. Action items:
- ari: SSO checklist + pilot form (due today)
- samir: pre-warm dev variant + dashboard tile (due Mon)
- alex_lumina: invite list + sample prompt set (done)
- maya: send meeting invite and pilot playbook link: https://go.redwood.example/pilot-playbook

alex_lumina: Got it. One more ask — can we set a renewal-risk flag if usage drops below X after week 4? Want to plan support interventions.

maya: We can add a retention alert rule. @samir can you recommend a threshold based on typical pilot patterns?

samir: Typically we see 30% drop after initial excitement; recommend threshold = 50% of expected daily calls for two consecutive days to trigger outreach. I'll codify that in the dashboard alert.

maya: Great. I'll update the playbook with the retention trigger and trench playbook for CS outreach.

ari: Shared draft checklist + form: https://go.redwood.example/lumina-ssocheck. Please review ASAP.

alex_lumina: Reviewed, minor edits on the form. Done. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks everyone — see you on Tue 10am PT. Closing this thread and will post the calendar invite. :party-parrot:
